name: RF L-series lenses
note: Full-frame RF lenses carrying Canon's L designation in the product name. Membership taken from Canon's naming, never inferred from price or specification.

name: RF L VCM primes
note: The RF20mm / RF24mm / RF35mm / RF50mm F1.4 L VCM hybrid stills-and-video primes (Marketed 2024-2025). Canon's museum pages describe a shared VCM-based focus design across the group.

name: RF non-L lenses
note: Full-frame RF lenses without the L designation: the STM primes and the consumer, travel and super-telephoto F11 zooms/primes.

name: RF-S lenses
note: APS-C lenses for the RF mount. Canon Camera Museum files them under its own 'RF-S Lens' category inside the RF Lenses series.

name: RF extenders
note: Extender RF1.4x and Extender RF2x, both Marketed July 2020 per the Canon Camera Museum.

name: EF L-series lenses
note: Full-frame EF lenses carrying Canon's L designation in the product name.

name: EF non-L lenses
note: Full-frame EF lenses without the L designation, including the EF50mm f/1.8 line, EF85mm f/1.8 USM and the EF40mm f/2.8 STM pancake.

name: EF-S lenses
note: APS-C lenses for the EF mount, introduced alongside the EOS 300D / DIGITAL REBEL. Canon Camera Museum category 'EF-S Lens'.

name: EF-M lenses
note: Lenses for the EF-M mirrorless mount (museum dates the mount '2012-'). Canon Camera Museum category 'EF-M Lens'. The newest member listed in the museum is the EF-M32mm f/1.4 STM, Marketed September 2018.

name: EF extenders
note: Extender EF1.4X III and Extender EF2X III, both Marketed December 2010 per the Canon Camera Museum.

name: TS-E tilt-shift lenses
note: Manual-focus tilt-shift EF lenses. Canon Camera Museum category 'TILT-SHIFT Lens'.

name: MP-E macro photo lenses
note: Canon's ultra-high-magnification macro designation; one EF member in the museum, the MP-E65mm f/2.8 1-5X Macro Photo.
